no_speech_rules: No spoken words. No voice. No narration. No lip-sync to dialogue.
Mouth closed or neutral rest — no talking, mumbling, whisper, or vocal sounds.
No microphone pickup of host speech — silent reaction clip only.

reference_image.instruction: Use the uploaded image as the exact character and scene reference. Match camera angle and framing. Host is listening, not speaking.
consistency_rules: Keep the same Pomplarion face and head shape.
Keep the same blue scaly skin texture and orange-glowing fin structures on the headphones.
Keep the same navy suit, white shirt, blue-orange plaid tie, Bitcoin lapel pin, black headphones, microphone, and blue-orange crypto broadcast studio.
Do not change the background HUD or wardrobe.
Do not make him look evil, angry, demonic, scary, or aggressive.

scene.character_description: Crypto broadcast host seated at desk with headphones and microphone, listening attentively to an off-screen guest.
scene.setting: Blue-orange crypto broadcast studio; same as speaking scenes.

camera.framing: Side profile medium close-up, attentive listen toward guest
camera.angle: Side profile medium close-up, attentive listen toward guest
camera.movement: Static camera or very subtle slow drift; no sudden moves
camera.eye_contact: Eyes toward guest or lens — attentive listen, not performing to camera

performance.energy: Attentive crypto host listening to Clinton off-camera; soft eye contact toward guest side
performance.facial_expression: Calm attentive listener; neutral or faint closed-mouth expression
performance.head_motion: Micro-nods and slight tilts only; return to center
performance.eye_motion: Natural blinking every 3-5 seconds; subtle eye tracking
body_motion: Slow natural chest and shoulder breathing visible throughout.
Small head movements only: micro-nods, slight tilt toward guest or mic, slow return to center.
Subtle eye movement — attentive listening, not staring blankly.
Minimal hand movement; hands rest on desk if visible.
mouth: Lips closed or slightly parted for idle breathing only — not shaped for words.
performance.hands: Still or minimal idle movement on desk

audio.ambient: Optional very subtle room tone only; no host speech

ending_state.action: Hold attentive listen pose through full duration.
ending_state.pose: Breathing visible, eyes alive, mouth at rest.
ending_state.transition: End mid-blink or mid-nod for invisible stitch to next listen clip.

quality.motion_style: natural idle listening — breathing, blink, micro head movement
quality.continuity: Pomplarion, navy suit, fin headphones, mic, blue-orange crypto studio; silent
